tool_args.rationale: The previous model failed fresh confirmation, so this revision compares several explicit ways for sink inhibition to couple to fast and slow adaptation. Parameters are fitted numerically, with leave-one-out error used to choose among the candidate coupling structures; fresh confirmation remains necessary.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eleven observations now cover short, intermediate, and long horizons; test revised stationary mechanisms before buying more measurements.

considered_alternatives.option: Static sink model or sink-free dual exponential
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations jointly show substantial sink dependence and a long-horizon sign reversal.
One failed confirmation does not refute all stationary smooth mechanisms, and no chaotic sign-oscillation signature was reported.
